title: Harden a DynamoDB Table
scenario: Enable encryption, point-in-time recovery and deletion protection on a DynamoDB table.

focus.title: Complete the aws_dynamodb_table resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_dynamodb_table.

hints.why: DynamoDB performance and cost depend on key design. Encoding that design in Terraform makes the access pattern explicit.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_dynamodb_table" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_dynamodb_table. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use DynamoDB for predictable key-based access at scale, especially when operational overhead must stay low.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_dynamodb_table" "this"`. Use this code shape: name; billing_mode; hash_key; deletion_protection_enabled; attribute { name; type }; server_side_encryption { enabled }; point_in_time_recovery { enabled }. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
